note: The build backend and every one of its dependencies, pinned by sha256 OUTSIDE pyproject.toml. PEP 517 gives [build-system].requires no place for a hash, so the wheels are vendored here and scripts/build_release.py verifies each digest BEFORE installing anything. Verifying after installation would verify a decision already taken. The wheels themselves are NOT in this tree: they are fetched once, on a build host, checked against these digests and committed alongside them. Until they are, the build refuses with BUILD_PIN_MISSING, which is the honest state — a build without pinned backend bytes is a function of what an index served that day.
